verdict.rationale: The App SDK docs reference an official `attio` CLI command (`attio migrate folder-structure`), and new apps come bootstrapped with AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for AI-assisted development. That suggests CLI tooling exists for app development, but the evidence shows only a single command and nothing about using a CLI to operate on workspace data. Missing for 10: documented CLI command reference, CLI support for reading or updating workspace records, install/auth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
